QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_24

question.text: Under Section 5.7.2, when establishing the overall SIA engagement strategy, the Social Impact Assessor should do ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Identify the characteristics of the engagement that define its audit scope
Ascertain the reporting objectives, timing, and nature of communications required
Predetermine the impact conclusion (Clean/Qualified) before fieldwork, to set expectations with the SE
Ascertain the nature, timing, and extent of resources necessary

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 5.7.2 lists seven items the SIA should do — A, B, and D are among them. Pre-determining the impact conclusion before fieldwork (C) would violate objectivity, evidence-based approach, and independence — three of the seven principles of Section 5.2. **The Trap:** All of A, B, D are literally in Section 5.7.2. Only C is inconsistent with the framework. **Cross-Exam Context:** NISM X-A / X-B (IA) and XV (RA) also prohibit pre-determined conclusions; XXIII is strict because SIA opinions drive SSE listing disclosure reliability. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** If a client nudges you toward a particular opinion at the planning stage, document the interaction in your working papers and reconsider the engagement — pre-determined opinions are a fundamental independence breach and a common disciplinary-case pattern.
